# Origen TechnolOG

Free real estate CRM for agents. No credit card. Set up in about 2 minutes.

Origen TechnolOG is a free CRM for real estate agents. Use it to organize contacts, manage tasks, and keep follow-ups from slipping. There is no paid plan for sale.

## Facts

- Free. No credit card.
- Setup takes about 2 minutes.
- Contact management, task reminders, and Google email/calendar integration are on the free tier.
- B.O.B. is an included AI assistant with a free daily message limit.
